name: dsh-plugin-token-usage
description: DeepSeek Harness Token usage dashboard. A dark TraeCode-style stats page (active-day heatmap, key metrics, partner/model preference, coding-hour curve). Adds a sidebar.panellist entry + a 'main' panel, and an optional conversation.view session tab (Config sessionTab) that carries the only real per-turn token usage stream DSH exposes to browser plugins.

scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/client.js && node scripts/smoke.mjs
